verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a SaaS mail-management service, so automation rules, and versioning, reviewing or rolling them back, are a fair question for it. The evidence describes only one-off operator requests (scan, forward, shred) and scheduled pickups. Nothing shows automation definitions, version history, review workflows or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
